#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
int n; int dx[4]={-1,1,0,0},dy[4]={0,0,-1,1};
int dir_[36];
unordered_set<unsigned long long> bad;
// state: occupancy bitmask (cars keep their cell's direction)
bool solve(unsigned long long m){
  if(!m) return true;
  if(bad.count(m)) return false;
  for(int p=0;p<n*n;p++) if(m>>p&1){
    int x=p/n,y=p%n,d=dir_[p];
    int nx=x+dx[d],ny=y+dy[d];
    unsigned long long m2=m&~(1ULL<<p);
    if(nx<0||ny<0||nx>=n||ny>=n){ if(solve(m2)) return true; continue;}
    int q=nx*n+ny; if(m>>q&1) continue;
    // car moves; direction moves with it
    // need direction per car: track via state encoding -> use dir array swap
    // simple: dir_ per position is mutable
    dir_[q]=d; // q was empty; its old dir irrelevant? it's empty so ok but must restore
    m2|=1ULL<<q;
    // dirs of other empty cells irrelevant
    int old=dir_[q]; (void)old;
    if(solve(m2)) return true;
  }
  bad.insert(m); return false;
}
